column1: # AC-M1.5 generic acceptance set (PLAN 7.7, W-M1.19), pre-registered 2026-11-07 before any engine change on this branch.
# Sixteen claimed classes, ten prompts each: feature-add, bug-symptom, refactor, delete, tests-only, performance, non-go,
# question, named-name, named-path, vague, greenfield, cross-cutting, knowledge-id, negation, pasted-error (multi-task
# stays W-M1.13; cross-repo stays M6). Rows of prompts.tsv and edge.tsv keep their ids and truths; the 105 new rows
# continue the letter series (JN named-name, JP named-path).
# Columns: id, class, unit, target, reuse, consumers, knowledge, allow, prompt. ';' separates alternatives any of which
# is right; '-' means no line of that kind is right; '*' leaves the cell unjudged; '\n' in a prompt is a newline.
# unit and target (the file the work lands in) and reuse (the existing file whose abstraction the work should call
# or extend rather than re-implement) are the first author's reading of the indexed tree (/tmp/rk-autosteer/acm11/tree,
# 65 units, the tree T1c indexed; it holds no internal/graph package). knowledge-id units are the units the id applies
# to in the graph; named-name units are the symbol's declaring file by grep; named-path units are the path's unit.
# consumers and knowledge are derived from the graph given the unit by test/live/autosteer/judge/derive_truths.py:
# consumers = files outside the unit whose declared symbols call, may_call or reference the unit's symbols, by count;
# knowledge = requirement, lesson and decision ids that apply to the unit, its files or its symbols. A unit of '-' gives
# consumers '-' and knowledge '-' (no unit line, no role lines). The target column is not judged by the engine test;
# it is the file list W-M1.20's discovery metric reads.
# Pre-registered gates per class (ten rows): unit line right in 8 of 10 (the 4 of 5 of AC-M1.1, basis disclosed);
# reuse line right in 6 of 10 of the rows judged; consumer lines right in 8 of 10; knowledge lines right in 8 of 10;
# all four counted over every row of the class (a brief on the wrong unit fails its role lines), with the rate given
# the unit right also printed. Right means: reuse, the kept reuse line's path is one of the truth's (or none when '-');
# consumers, every kept consumer line's path is in the derived set and at least one is kept when the set is non-empty;
# knowledge, every kept knowledge line's id is in the derived set and at least one is kept when the set is non-empty.
# Second read (2026-11-07, blind, Sonnet 5, three readers per row given the atlas and their batch only; 24 calls,
# 1,786,148 tokens against an estimate of 1.56M): unit 149 of 160 confirmed, Fleiss kappa 0.891; reuse 31 of 140
# judged confirmed, kappa 0.814, and in 82 of the 109 others the readers' majority is the row's target, the edit
# point. The reader prompt ("call, extend or move code into") let the edit point stand for the abstraction, so that
# read does not test the reuse cells; the reuse re-read below replaces it for them. Adjudication
# rules, fixed before adjudicating: R1 a truth is replaced only when the tree shows it cannot hold the work; R2 a
# truth gains the readers' answer when the object the prompt names is declared there; R3 a knowledge-id unit is the
# graph's applies_to set unless the record's own text names the work's location; R4 reuse is the abstraction to
# build on, never the edit point. Changed, development half: unit A4 + cmd/rashomon, H3 + internal/install;
# acceptance half: unit O10 + cmd/rashomon, N10 + pgraph/cmd/pgraph, N8 + '-', reuse PL12 +
# internal/verify/obligations.go, M4 + internal/store/deadline.go, M8 + internal/harness/detect.go, JP4 '-' ->
# internal/store/lab.go; consumers and knowledge re-derived on the five unit rows (the union over alternatives).
# The adjudicator was not blind: it had seen the first run's picks, and A4 and O10 were first-run misses this
# revision makes right. edge.tsv keeps its truths for A4 and H3: AC-M1.1 is closed on them. N10's pgraph/cmd/pgraph
# alternative has empty consumer and knowledge sets, so under the registered union rule a brief on it scores its
# role lines wrong; the rule stays. Judged by TestACM15_ClassesTable (internal/graph/engine/acm15_test.go),
# RASHOMON_ACM11_DIR the tree and RASHOMON_ACM15_CLASSES this file.
# Reuse re-read (2026-11-07, blind, Sonnet 5, three readers per row given the atlas and their batch only, each row
# showing the request, the unit truth and the edit point (target) first; the readers named the existing file the work
# should build on, never an edit point, with a symbol declared in it, or '-'; 24 calls, 1,786,084 tokens against an
# estimate of 1.8M). Rules and adjudicator fixed before any answer: A1 a majority is 2 of 3; A3 (R4) a truth that is
# an edit point is removed; A4 (R2) a majority file gains as an alternative ('-' stays beside it, R1) when A5 holds:
# a file of the tree and graph, not an edit point, a reader's symbol for it declared there, and a word of that
# symbol (case and '_' split, 4+ letters) or the file's name in the request or its knowledge record by substring.
# Result: 96 of 140 confirmed, Fleiss kappa 0.642 (138 rows read three times; one reader skipped JP3 and E2); 18
# rows gain the majority's file; C3 and C4 lose their edit point and become '-'; truths stay on 4 rows whose majority
# is '-' (R1), 13 with no majority and 9 whose majority fails A5. The substring test admits generic words (platform,
# user, rows, header, files, config, gate, question); each gain sits beside the old truth, so a brief that gave the
# old answer stays right. A '-' among alternatives is met by no reuse line (judgeAny). Changed, development half:
# PG12, A2, B7, C3, J2, JP7, N1, O1, O3, O7, O9, P1; acceptance half: A3, C4, D8, JN3, JP2, N2, P4, P6. The
# adjudicator had seen the engine's output on these rows; the rules left it no choice on any row.
# The consumer and knowledge judges are correctness judges over a set (no line the graph does not support, and at least
# one when the set is non-empty); which of a unit's consumers the brief should rank first is W-M1.20's question.
